evidence_policy: No numerical value is entered without an identified source or explicitly approved assumption.

parameters.mathematical_definition: Duration from exposure into E to transition into I; sigma = 1 / incubation_period.
parameters.source: Lauer et al., Ann Intern Med, https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC7081172
parameters.exact_evidence_supporting_value: 181 confirmed cases; median incubation 5.1 days (95% CI 4.5-5.8).
parameters.applicability_to_covid_modelling_period: Must be explicitly specified for the COVID period, population, and variant scope being modelled.
parameters.limitations: Evidence is early-pandemic and symptom-based; variant, age, severity, and population differences limit transferability. It must not be inferred from the OWID curve alone.

parameters.source: Derived from sourced incubation_period; Lauer et al. publication date 2020-03-10
parameters.applicability_to_covid_modelling_period: Derived only after a sourced incubation period is accepted for the selected COVID modelling period.
parameters.limitations: Sigma inherits the incubation evidence and the project proxy from incubation to E-to-I timing; incubation and latent period are not identical.

parameters.mathematical_definition: Duration governing removal/recovery from I; gamma = 1 / infectious_recovery_period.
parameters.source: Cevik et al., Lancet Microbe, https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC7837230
parameters.exact_evidence_supporting_value: No live virus was isolated beyond day 9; no respiratory sample after day 8 yielded live virus. Eight days is an explicit operational assumption, not an RNA shedding duration.
parameters.applicability_to_covid_modelling_period: Must be explicitly specified for the COVID period, population, and clinical definition being modelled.
parameters.limitations: The 8-day value is an operational assumption anchored to viable-virus evidence, not a universal population infectiousness duration; RNA shedding is not used as a substitute.

parameters.source: Derived from sourced infectious_recovery_period; Cevik et al. publication date 2020-11-19
parameters.applicability_to_covid_modelling_period: Derived only after a sourced infectious/recovery period is accepted for the selected COVID modelling period.
parameters.limitations: Gamma inherits the operational infectious-period assumption and its variant, severity, treatment, vaccination, and sampling limitations.

parameters.mathematical_definition: mu is the per-time transition rate from I to D in dI/dt = sigma*E - (gamma + mu)*I and dD/dt = mu*I.
parameters.source: Derived from Verity et al. IFR and primary gamma; https://europepmc.org/article/MED/32240634
parameters.applicability_to_covid_modelling_period: Requires an explicit mapping appropriate to the COVID population, period, disease definition, and SEIRD compartment structure.
parameters.limitations: The approved OWID mortality outcome is a lagged reported CFR-like measure and is not used. The competing-hazard mapping from early China IFR to mu is an explicit assumption with age and period limitations.

parameters.unit: method specification; beta would be 1/day when calculated
parameters.mathematical_definition: For dS/dt=-beta*S*I/N and dI/dt=sigma*E-(gamma+mu)*I, R0=beta/(gamma+mu) at full susceptibility and Reff=beta*S/[N*(gamma+mu)]. The Cori renewal-ratio Rt_estimated is treated as Reff for the mechanics replay, giving beta(t)=Rt_estimated(t)*(gamma+mu)*N/S(t) at the transition start. beta=Rt_estimated*(gamma+mu) is only a full-susceptibility/R0 mapping (or an S/N approximately 1 approximation). Use only valid Rt_estimated observations; do not substitute OWID reproduction_rate or intervention coefficients.
parameters.exact_evidence_supporting_value: The approved Rt output is independently estimated and explicitly distinguished from OWID reproduction_rate. The intervention analysis is documented as non-predictive and excluded from calibration.
parameters.applicability_to_covid_modelling_period: Applicable only as a mechanical retrospective replay after gamma, mu, valid Rt periods, and the model transition-start S are supplied. It is not a validated case-calibration method.
parameters.limitations: Numerical beta remains conditional on valid Rt periods, transition-start S, and selected scenario parameters; missing Rt periods remain unavailable and beta is time-varying. Approved inputs do not identify a case ascertainment or reporting-delay observation model.
parameters.readiness: READY METHOD / NUMERIC BETA CONDITIONAL ON Rt

mortality_definitions.CFR: Reported deaths divided by reported cases under a stated observation window.
mortality_definitions.IFR: Deaths among all infections, including infections that were not observed or reported.
mortality_definitions.mortality_probability: Probability of death over a specified disease course or compartment transition.
mortality_definitions.mortality_transition_rate: Per-time rate mu governing the I-to-D compartment flow.
mortality_definitions.approved_owid_outcome: Lagged reported CFR-like outcome; not interchangeable with IFR, mortality probability, or mu.

primary_parameter_set.purpose: Main COVID modelling assumption set selected from the strongest applicable supplied evidence.
primary_parameter_set.selection_rule: Historical 2020 primary set; infectious period is an explicit operational assumption anchored to viable-virus evidence.

alternative_parameter_sets.name: shorter_duration_set
alternative_parameter_sets.purpose: Assess a defensibly shorter sourced incubation and/or infectious/recovery period.
alternative_parameter_sets.selection_rule: Populate only from an identified source or approved assumption; do not choose values to improve validation metrics.

alternative_parameter_sets.name: longer_duration_set
alternative_parameter_sets.purpose: Assess a defensibly longer sourced incubation and/or infectious/recovery period.
alternative_parameter_sets.selection_rule: Populate only from an identified source or approved assumption; do not choose values to improve validation metrics.

alternative_parameter_sets.name: variant_or_period_set
alternative_parameter_sets.purpose: Represent a source-supported change across COVID variants or historical periods when applicability differs.
alternative_parameter_sets.selection_rule: Use only where the source explicitly supports the variant/period distinction and document transferability limits.

comparison_plan: Record source and applicability for every set.
Derive sigma and gamma mathematically within each set.
Define the mortality mapping to mu before calculating beta.
Use the same chronological calibration and validation design for comparable sets.
Report parameter sensitivity separately from model performance; do not select a set solely because it improves metrics.
Reject any set with missing evidence, inconsistent units, negative rates, or unsupported mortality interpretation.
